name: Stay Well Weighted Blanket - at Relax The Back
description: The Stay Well Weighted Blanket simulates firm, cozy hug sensation that helps us feel comforted and secure. Weighted blankets have been known to provide Deep Touch Pressure (DTP) which may help relieve anxiety and promote tranquility, enabling deep, rejuvenating sleep. The Stay Well Blanket encourages restful sleep, refreshing mornings, and productive days. Weighted blankets have been used by the medical community to treat insomnia, anxiety, depression and Posttraumatic Stress Disord (PTSD). Features & Benefits: Ultra-Soft Premium Cotton - Breathable HygroCotton, a breakthrough technology in ultra-soft, ultra-absorbent cotton, helps regulate temperature and wick moisture, keeping you cool in the summer and warm in the winter .Glass Bead Fill - Smooth non-toxic glass beads are an allergen-safe alternative to conventional polyester beads, providing a seamless texture across the blanket Antimicrobial Technology - Durable Protx2" is woven into the outer duvet layer. A cutting-edge technology that combats odor-causing bacteria and provides anti-microbial protection that endures through each wash, for long-lasting freshness Practical Design - Individually stitched pockets distribute weight and pressure evenly across the body. Fabric loops stitched into the corners and along the sides securely attach the cover to the blanket, while a zipper ensures fast and easy enclosure outside of the blanket Easy Care - Removable, easy-to-fit, and durable blanket cover is machine washable and dryer safe. The blanket itself is dry clean only
